neighbours.label: ' lot' in 'a lot (of)' and other large-quantity intensifiers (heavily)
fire: There has been a lot of debate about the new parking rules.
Our team spends a lot of time fixing old bugs.
The town relies heavily on summer tourism for income.
She has become a lot more confident since starting the job.
We received a lot of letters after the article appeared.
The region depends heavily on imported grain.
He talks a lot about his time in the navy.
Students use a lot of shortcuts when writing essays.
quiet: There has been some debate about the new parking rules.
Our team spends the morning fixing old bugs.
The town relies on summer tourism for income.
She has become more confident since starting the job.
We received several letters after the article appeared.
The region imports grain from abroad.
He talks about his time in the navy.
Students use shortcuts when writing essays.

notes: Card: ' lot' x19 (a lot), ' heavily' x5. Output suppresses lot/heavily/emphasis on + side.
